meta.name: notaire
meta.description:
Notaire IA pour le droit immobilier, les successions, les donations, le droit de la famille
et le droit des sociétés en France. Copilote juridique pour la préparation d'actes, le conseil
patrimonial, les calculs de frais et la vérification de conformité.

Couvre le calcul des frais de notaire (DMTO, émoluments, débours, CSI), la plus-value
immobilière, les droits de succession et donation, le démembrement, les contrats de mariage,
les PACS, les SCI, et la rédaction de projets d'actes (compromis, statuts, testaments).

Triggers: notaire, frais de notaire, acte de vente, compromis, succession, donation, héritage, testament, PACS, contrat de mariage, SCI, plus-value immobilière, droits de mutation, DMTO, usufruit, nue-propriété, partage successoral, réserve héréditaire, viager, donation-partage, diagnostics immobilier, droit de préemption, acte notarié, droit immobilier

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 计算法国房产交易与继承相关税费并准备法律文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要处理法国房产买卖、继承或捐赠的法律与税务事宜。
copy.tagline_en: Calculate French real estate and inheritance taxes and prepare legal documents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle French real estate transactions, inheritance, or donation legal and tax matters.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先要求你确认操作类型、当事人与房产信息,然后计算公证费、继承/赠与税等,并按模板起草购房承诺书、遗嘱、SCI 章程等文书草稿。
howto.when: 当用户提到“notaire”“succession”“donation”等关键词,或要求计算公证费、解答继承赠与问题、起草法国法律文书时触发。

say.text: 帮我估算购买这套房的公证费,房子在巴黎,价格50万欧元。
say.note: 它会先核实交易信息,再分项计算各项费用。

say.text: 父亲去世了,继承人是我和母亲,帮我算继承税。
say.note: 它会要求补充死亡日期与房产清单,再计算继承税。

say.text: 我想立一份遗嘱,给我一个模板。
say.note: 它会按你的家庭情况套用遗嘱模板。

howto.what_en: Acts as a French notarial legal assistant: confirms the deal context, then computes notary fees, inheritance/gift taxes, and drafts purchase promises, wills, SCI articles from templates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like “notaire”, “succession”, “donation”, or asks to calculate notary fees, solve inheritance/gift questions, or draft French legal documents.

say_en.text: Estimate the notary fees for this apartment purchase in Paris, price €500,000.
say_en.note: Confirms the deal context first, then details each fee.

say_en.text: My father passed away; heirs are my mother and me. Calculate inheritance tax.
say_en.note: Asks for death date and asset list, then computes tax.

say_en.text: I want to draft a will. Give me a template.
say_en.note: Uses the will template based on your family situation.
